name: perforin 1

function.text: PRF1 encodes perforin-1. Annotated molecular activities include pore-forming activity and wide pore channel activity. It participates in apoptotic process and protein homooligomerization.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis 2 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
